017286:         // has its value before a later object's bound is checked. File-scope

017299:             {

017301:             }
017302:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) ||

017305:                 if (depth)
